title: Form search ranking

metrics.reason: informational alongside the gated top1/forbidden_hits — top3 has never regressed independently of top1 in this 12-case fixture, so it is reported rather than floored to avoid a second near-duplicate gate

notes: Promotes scripts/sage-form-harness.mjs (config/sage-form-eval.json, 12 cases) to a gated benchmark. Runs IN-PROCESS — searchForms() is imported directly from src/lib/spokes/form-search.ts (production code), never re-implemented. No DB or model required: the form-search embedding path falls back to keyword-only ranking when the embedding API is unreachable, same as production. THIS SUITE MEASURES KEYWORD-ONLY RANKING BY CONSTRUCTION: searchForms() picks hybrid or keyword based on whether an embedding index is reachable, which is a property of the environment rather than of the code under test, and the committed baseline (top1 0.917) was measured keyword-only. The mode is therefore a declared input — FORM_RANKING_MODE=keyword (default) or hybrid — and off_mode_cases counts every case that ran under a different one, floored at 0, so a database that gains form embeddings fails this gate loudly and names the offending cases instead of silently reporting a different top1. Switching to hybrid is legitimate but must be deliberate: set FORM_RANKING_MODE=hybrid, re-measure, and re-baseline with a reason. See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-05-benchmark-suite.md §4.3.
